notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes: [p][b]Greetings, galactic captains![/b][/p][p]We have some news about development. Right now, we are preparing a new demo for [b]NEXT FEST[/b] in October.[/p][p][b]First[/b] - the battle system. We are still working to make it more fun, but now it is easier to read and understand for the player.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693194/00f2ed4711476d1d4801fc8b4339ed9a7bdc32b2.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Second[/b] - we made unique skins for ship types. Every ship has a class, not only a level. For example, pirates have:[/p][list][*][p][b]Raider[/b] - stronger weapons, more damage;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Brute[/b] - more health and strong attacks;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hunter[/b] - higher chance for critical damage.[/p][/*][/list][p]To show this better and give more character, we gave every type its own unique look.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693194/40ed106173f307969226550cdc3159ecfda74c59.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693194/9c78897472823841df81bf08eabcb5d551871d20.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Third[/b] – more content and mechanics are coming. Sector system, new stations, new enemy ships, and more will wait for you in October.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693194/0d0aefbd247005fbb0f9b565918772bcc9547536.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Stay tuned and follow the news so you don’t miss anything![/b][/p]

notes.title: Roadmap (AUG-OCT)
notes.notes:
[p][b]Greetings![/b][/p][p]We want to share our roadmap for the next months.
After the [b]Ukrainian Games Festival[/b] we got a new audience. We are very happy about this. We got your feedback and already fixed some things in the demo (you can still play it!).[/p][p]We also want to say that we are preparing for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. We want to finish all points for this moment.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Improvements of existing content:[/b][/p][p]• Better combat system and easier to read[/p][p]• Add tutorial to the game[/p][p]• More game lore[/p][p]• Rework of reputation system[/p][p]• Better UI[/p][p][b]New content:[/b][/p][p]• New enemy ships[/p][p]• New player ship hulls[/p][p]• Three new stations and new mechanics[/p][p]• Hire crew members at stations[/p][p]• Use reputation to change life in the sector[/p][p][b]Extra:[/b][/p][p]• Global map with 3 sectors[/p][p][/p][p]More content is coming this roadmap is not the last one. We will share new details soon.[/p][p]Remember, we have a [url="https://discord.gg/N8EBwz6r"]Discord channel[/url]. There we post news earlier and small dev updates. You can also give your feedback and ask questions.
Join us and stay with us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693194/e44cde2147b3ac820b48ac51cf68cec8c4630f39.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 1000 wishlists! and discord server
notes.notes: [p]Thank you very much for your support. During the festival we got more than [b]1000 wishlists[/b]. Yes, 1000 wishlists can look like a small number, but for our team it is a big event.[/p][p][/p][p]We also got your feedback - some negative and some positive. Every feedback is good for us, because positive gives us motivation, and negative shows our weak points that we must improve.[/p][p][/p][p]We are happy that our project could interest you.[/p][p]For this we made a [url="https://discord.gg/N8EBwz6r" style="button"]Discord[/url] server, where we will share news and details of development, and also get feedback from you directly.[/p][p][/p][p]Soon (in about 2 weeks) we will close the demo and invite volunteers for early testing with a form.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow the updates. Thank you for being with us![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version and Participation in Ukrainian Games Festival 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hello![/p][p]
Today I am happy to share that we are taking part in the [b]Ukrainian Games Festival[/b]. For this event, we released a demo version of our game, and you can try it now.[/p][p][/p][p]It is very important for us to get your feedback. This will help us make the game better and more interesting for you. At the end of the demo, or when you lose, you will see a pop-up where you can leave your feedback about the gameplay and, if you want, share your ideas for the future of the project.[/p][p][/p][p]Please note: the demo version may have some bugs. Also, the save system is turned off for now because the game length is currently 125 turns.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being with us! We hope you will enjoy what we prepared.[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #1 — Reworking the Combat System
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693194/606b607d9b2a6fb56ddd72a7493c11bd28a324ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]So, we’re starting this small devlog to share more about the development process and the game itself.[/p][p][/p][p]The combat system has always been one of the most important parts of the game. What we currently have is simple and casual. That’s why we decided to improve and expand it — to give the player more control over how battles play out, and to make the system more flexible overall.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693194/7a8cbc085370ba9b4f94a4e865458b808fb0e9ec.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Now, both player and enemy ship hulls will have different levels of protection and specific weak points.
Less protected parts will take less damage, while heavily armored areas — which are harder to hit — will take more. Still, even if you miss the target, there will be some minimal damage applied anyway.[/p][p][/p][p]The game already has ship upgrades, hull purchases, and other elements that affect your ship — like the crew. In the future, we may add even more mechanics like that. This new flexible combat system gives us the freedom to expand.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue sharing various insights — both lore-related and development-focused — so stay tuned![/p]
